summary: PrimeEnergy Resources Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its borrowing base agreement with Citibank, N.A., decreasing the borrowing base from $115 million to $105 million, effective August 3, 2026. The company had no outstanding borrowings under the credit facility as of March 31, 2026, and continues to have none. This is a routine credit facility modification, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic events are involved. The filing is a standard material agreement disclosure under Item 1.01, with no implications for acquisitions, divestitures, or other special-situations categories. Watch for any future borrowing base changes or financial covenant impacts, but no risk-arb angle applies.
